SUN_S1E09_P01.speaker: Mira Sloan
SUN_S1E09_P01.text: Good. Wash your hands before you touch my bread.

SUN_S1E09_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P01.text: She thought somebody would object to Kael.

SUN_S1E09_P02.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P02.text: I want to stay a few days.

SUN_S1E09_P02.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P02.text: A man is dying. I am allowed some imprecision.

SUN_S1E09_P02.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P02.text: I know. I am apparently arguing in advance now.

SUN_S1E09_P02.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P02.text: Does she want to see him?

SUN_S1E09_P02.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P02.text: Does he want to see her?

SUN_S1E09_P02.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P02.text: Then I'll start with the person who can still walk away.

SUN_S1E09_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E09_P03.text: He looks like somebody who would be.

SUN_S1E09_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P03.text: Making a person out of the shape of a story.

SUN_S1E09_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P03.text: They know he loses money politely, hates sweet coffee, and helps Pell outside every afternoon.

SUN_S1E09_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P03.text: I do. I just think you keep waiting for the wrong kind of knowing.

SUN_S1E09_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P03.text: Probably while you were writing things down.

SUN_S1E09_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E09_P04.text: If proximity mattered, this place should be unbearable.

SUN_S1E09_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E09_P04.text: Maybe only some of them matter.

SUN_S1E09_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P04.text: Or maybe some of them aren't the same thing.

SUN_S1E09_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E09_P04.text: Same material. Same ribbing. Same surface wear.

SUN_S1E09_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P04.text: Three dogs can all be brown.

SUN_S1E09_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E09_P04.text: Saint Oren's is ruining your chart.

SUN_S1E09_P05.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P05.text: They spoke. He apologized badly. She forgave him incompletely. It was enough for tonight.

SUN_S1E09_P05.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P05.text: Then call it that if it helps.

SUN_S1E09_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E09_P05.text: Sometimes you only get the part people can still do.

SUN_S1E09_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P05.text: You only notice because you like arguments.

SUN_S1E09_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P06.text: You hate sweet coffee, you cheat at nothing, and you're embarrassingly bad at cards.

SUN_S1E09_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E09_P06.text: I object to the last one.

SUN_S1E09_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E09_P06.text: There it is. His first conspiracy theory.

SUN_S1E09_P06.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E09_P06.text: I do. That's why I said it.

SUN_S1E09_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E09_P06.text: I would be pleased if it became a pattern.

SUN_S1E09_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E09_P06.text: You don't get to choose the pattern.
